title: Board Dividend Practice Note: Election Withdrawal Interest on Long-Standing Whole Life Insurance Accumulation Deposits
content:
On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the interest rate on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election is raised for a long-standing deposit, judged by the number of anniversaries at which a dividend was placed on deposit, as shown by the dividend deposit entries on the policy ledger.

**Practice.** Where there are at least **10** dividend deposit entries, the rate is raised by **0.40 percentage point (0.004)**; where there are at least **5** but fewer than 10, by **0.20 percentage point (0.002)**; where there are fewer than 5, it is not raised on this account.

**Counting.** Every dividend deposit entry on the policy's activity history counts once, whatever its amount and however long ago it was booked.

| Dividend deposit entries | Increase |
|---|---|
| 0 to 4 | None |
| 5 to 9 | 0.002 |
| 10 or more | 0.004 |

**Examples (hypothetical, declared rate 3.75%).** Nine deposit entries: 3.95%. Ten deposit entries: 4.15%. Four deposit entries: 3.75%.
